title: LAW OF MARINE INSURANCE II
modules: Definition Of Consumerism And Consumer Rights
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an asset and can be transferred."
Marine Insurance Policy is an asset and can be transferred.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a claims specialist appointed by an insurance company to investigate a contentious claim it is called upon to pay."
A loss adjuster is a claims specialist appointed by an insurance company to investigate a contentious claim it is called upon to pay.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a formal document issued to an insured to protect him against the occurrence of the risk in the interval between the submission of the proposal form and the issue of the insurance policy."

The provisional cover is a formal document issued to an insured to protect him against the occurrence of the risk in the interval between the submission of the proposal form and the issue of the insurance policy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the information advanced by the assured to the insurer."
Representation is the information advanced by the assured to the insurer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used or skill employed must be for the best interest of the principal ultimately."
Whatever care is used or skill employed must be for the best interest of the principal ultimately.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important professional intermediary in the insurance industry."
The insurance broker is a very important professional intermediary in the insurance industry.
fib: ______ means transferring the policy by the assured who is called the "assignor" to a third party called the "assignee" so as to enable the assignee to enforce the policy in his own name.

Assignment of policy of insurance means transferring the policy by the assured who is called the "assignor" to a third party called the "assignee" so as to enable the assignee to enforce the policy in his own name.
______ is a charge by which the assured undertakes to do a particular thing or satisfy a particular condition or affirms or negates the existence of a particular state of facts.
Warranty is a charge by which the assured undertakes to do a particular thing or satisfy a particular condition or affirms or negates the existence of a particular state of facts.
______ is a fundamental term of the contract, the breach of which entitles the other party to rescind the contract and claim for damages.
A condition is a fundamental term of the contract, the breach of which entitles the other party to rescind the contract and claim for damages.
______ is a loss falling generally on all interest involved in a maritime venture as distinguished from particular average or a loss falling on one particular interest.
General average is a loss falling generally on all interest involved in a maritime venture as distinguished from particular average or a loss falling on one particular interest.
______ is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance.
A policy of insurance is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance.
